title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
title_bn: ওপেনএআই নতুন রাউন্ডের জন্য তহবিলের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা কমিয়ে দিয়েছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: OpenAI’s latest funding round doesn't seem to be living up to expectations.
paragraph1: In Brief Posted: 9:12 AM PDT · October 31, 2026 Image Credits:Samuel Boivin/NurPhoto / Getty Images OpenAI’s latest funding round isn’t quite living up to expectations, according to multiple news reports. OpenAI was previously reported to be raising $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation, and then at a $1.
paragraph2: 25 trillion valuation, ahead of a planned IPO. But The Financial Times reported Friday that the company has subsequently lowered its funding target to $20 billion, with a first close that’s expected to be even lower than that. The round will be led by a group of investors from the United Arab Emirates, the FT said.
paragraph3: A subsequent retail offering for wealthy individuals could bring the total funding amount to the $20 billion target. A follow-up story in The Wall Street Journal offered more details, namely that the company has secured $11 billion so far, and that its fundraising efforts had met with a “tepid” response from some large investors. TechCrunch has reached out to OpenAI for comment.
paragraph4: The company’s reported funding challenges could be blamed, in part, on bad timing, as Wall Street investors have become wary of heavy AI infrastructure spending, leading to a major sell off of tech stocks. And Anthropic’s planned IPO could be facing challenges, too.

title: French lawmakers approve $11.2 billion internet tax based on traffic usage, costs $0.65 per gigabyte of content accessed

author: TechPulse
excerpt: French lawmakers have approved an amendment proposing a €0.055-per-gigabyte tax on digital content delivered to internet subscribers in France. The measure could generate an estimated €10 billion annually, with companies including Google, Meta, Netfl
paragraph1: (Image credit: Getty Images) France has approved a proposed tax that aims to tax the amount of internet data per gigabyte sent to French users in the country, with major companies like Google, Netflix, TikTok, and Meta now in the crosshairs. According to minutes released by the National Assembly, members voted 11-10 in support of the motion on October 30 — which now means the new law has been added to the country’s next budget, despite major opposition from the government side and the finance committee rapporteur. The latest amendment, introduced by socialist lawmaker Laurent Lhardit, could see content providers pay €0.55 (roughly $0.
paragraph2: 62) to the government for every gigabyte of content distributed to French users.With approximately 154 million users and counting in France, the proposal’s authors say such a tax could generate around €10 billion ($11.2 billion) in annual revenue for the government. “This amendment proposes a tax on digital data flows emitted by content providers, to be borne by the providers themselves.
paragraph3: Its revenue is estimated at €10 billion.” Said Laurent Lhardit. The said proposal, though yet to be passed as it must survive further parliamentary scrutiny, aims at companies that generate substantial internet traffic as opposed to taxing their advertising revenue, profits and subscriptions. Its explanatory notes particularly mention Google, Meta, Netflix, Amazon, and content delivery network Akamai as major potential contributors.

title: From restaurant guides to payments, here’s how TikTok is building a super app
title_bn: রেস্তোরাঁর গাইড থেকে শুরু করে পেমেন্ট পর্যন্ত, টিকটক কিভাবে একটি সুপার অ্যাপ তৈরি করছে তা এখানে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: TikTok may be working to become the app that people use for most of their digital activities.
paragraph1: TikTok announced this week that it’s adding an in-app restaurant guide, marking another step in the platform’s expansion beyond social media. The company has also recently been spotted developing a feature that would allow users to send money over direct messages. The social media app has steadily expanded its offerings in recent years, adding TikTok Shop, a map for local discovery, more robust search features, games, and more. It appears that TikTok is taking steps to evolve into a “super app,” a single platform where users can do much more than just watch and share videos and that can actually handle a wide range of needs in one destination. The super app model is big in China with apps like WeChat, which is kind of like Facebook, WhatsApp, Apple Pay, and an app store all rolled into a single platform. Of course, there’s the question of whether a super app model would work outside of China, but that doesn’t mean TikTok won’t try. Instead of switching between apps, TikTok is working to become the app that people use for most of their digital activities. After taking its biggest leap with TikTok Shop, the company — which, notably, transitioned to new, primarily U.S. ownership back in January — has applied the same playbook to recent developments. Restaurant Guides Image Credits:TikTok TikTok has become a popular destination for restaurant recommendations, with viral videos often driving customers to local eateries. Now, the platform is looking to make that discovery process even easier with a new feature called “Must Eat.
paragraph2: ” The community-driven guide highlights restaurants getting attention on the platform. “Must Eat” draws on more than 40 million posts and comments to compile restaurant recommendations and curated lists in one place. Users can browse restaurants by city and narrow their search by cuisine, price, rating, and location. The move puts TikTok in more direct competition with platforms like Yelp and Google Maps. It also reflects how the app is expanding its role in users’ everyday decisions, from what they buy to where they choose to go out to eat. Payments Image Credits:Just_Super / Getty Images Bloomberg reported in August that TikTok is developing a feature that would allow users to send each other money via direct messages. If rolled out, the feature would use the social media service’s TikTok Pay offering, which is already available in Southeast Asia for TikTok Shop purchases. Additionally, Reuters reported in March that TikTok had applied to Brazil’s central bank for approval to operate as a financial technology company offering lending and payment services. TikTok’s potential expansion into payments marks a significant way that the company is branching out beyond a social media platform and into a digital ecosystem. By aiming to bring financial services into its app, TikTok is looking to increase user engagement, open new revenue streams, and position itself to compete with fintech startups and e-commerce platforms. Sports Image Credits:TechCrunch/Screenshot Over the years, TikTok has steadily been looking to become a place where users can come for sports highlights and content. In early June, the company launched a dedicated hub for the FIFA World Cup where users can see scores, match schedules, standings, trending videos, highlights, videos from players, and more.
paragraph3: If people are already watching videos on TikTok but want to keep up with the score, they can do so without leaving the app or opening a dedicated sports news app or Google. The World Cup hub was made possible through TikTok’s Sports-focused product called “TikTok GamePlan,” which is designed to allow sports teams, leagues, and broadcasters to drive discovery and engagement on the platform. The social media giant also has partnerships with Major League Soccer (MLS) and Major League Baseball (MLB) for behind-the-scenes and exclusive content. Hotel and attraction booking Image Credits:TikTok In May, TikTok launched TikTok GO, a way for users to discover and book hotels, attractions, and experiences directly within its app in the United States. TikTok GO surfaces lodging and things to do through videos, search, and location pages. When users find something they’re interested in, they can view details, check availability, and complete a booking. Instead of directing users to third-party websites after they find a destination or recommendation in a video, TikTok has started positioning itself as a one-stop platform where viral travel content can drive bookings and revenue. While people have already been using TikTok as a search engine and replacement for Google, this latest step puts TikTok in more direct competition with Google’s core businesses, Search and Google Maps, because it’s working to not only be the app where you discover places, but also the platform where you purchase that trip. TikTok Shop Image Credits:TikTok It’s widely known that one of TikTok’s biggest leaps beyond social media was the launch of TikTok Shop. TikTok began testing TikTok Shop in 2021 and launched it in the U.S. in 2023.
paragraph4: Since then, the company has been able to successfully compete with Amazon, Shein, and other online marketplaces. According to eMarketer, TikTok Shop grew its U.S. sales by 407% in 2024 and another 108% in 2025 to reach $15.82 billion. As of last year, the company accounted for 18.2% of total social commerce in the U.S., with that number expected to reach 24.1% by 2027. Additionally, TikTok began challenging digital marketplaces even further with the launch of TikTok Shop gift cards late last year. TikTok Shop has also recently expanded into luxury retail, after initially mainly being known for cheap goods.
paragraph5: Music Image Credits:TikTok TikTok’s popularity has influenced the music industry and how people discover new music, and the company tried to capitalize on this by launching a streaming service called TikTok Music in 2023 to take on platforms like Spotify and Apple Music, but ended up shutting it down a year later. The company said it would focus on driving music listening and continue partnering with music streaming services rather than competing with them. TikTok hasn’t completely abandoned its music ambitions, however, as the company recently introduced a feature that lets Apple Music subscribers play full songs in the app after discovering them on their “For You” feed. Search and Maps Image Credits:Screenshot/TechCrunch TikTok has launched a robust search experience that surfaces maps, local hashtags, and even reviews to help users discover trending restaurants, travel locations, shops, and local experiences. It has also added more detailed information about places and restaurants on dedicated pages, allowing users to quickly see things like opening hours, star ratings, price ranges, and more. TikTok was already eating into Google’s Search business when it first launched, as it quickly surfaced videos featuring commentary and visuals of restaurant food and places. However, users may still have needed to turn to Google Search to find a place’s exact location or to read reviews. Over the past few years, however, TikTok has increasingly eliminated that need by integrating detailed information about places right within its app. Microdramas Image Credits:TikTok While TikTok is known for user-generated entertainment, the company has also begun embracing microdramas by launching an in-app Minis section and a dedicated stand-alone app for bite-sized TV shows that can be watched in a series of one-minute episodes. While TikTok already competes with streaming giants like Netflix for users’ attention, its move into scripted shows puts it in even more direct competition with them. It’s worth noting that TikTok first took strides into entertainment with the launch of livestreaming and support for longer videos, a significant move away from its initial focus on 15-second videos.

title: 'Ghost Students' using AI to apply for student loans with stolen identities, DOJ's Operation Ghostbusters busts $200 million ring

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Fraudsters are using the identities of high school graduates who skipped college to apply for student loans and steal the excess proceeds that do not go to schools. They use AI to keep the charade going and make it seem like the fake student is actua
paragraph1: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) just announced indictments resulting from Operation Ghostbusters, which investigated widespread student loan fraud.
paragraph2: According to the agency, bad actors used stolen identities to sign up for student loans and used AI to complete the application, making it appear that the fake student was attending online classes.While the schools receive the majority of the proceeds of the fraudulent student loan, the remaining amount is funneled into the bank accounts of the fraudsters, who then use mules to move the money from U.S.
paragraph3: bank accounts to overseas conspirators. On the other hand, unwitting victims who have skipped college and instead directly joined the workforce after high school are saddled with student debt for a degree they never even signed up for.Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.

title: New-Age Tech Stocks Gain This Week Led By Ather & Zetwerk, CarTrade Sinks 22%
title_bn: এ সপ্তাহে নিউ-এজ টেকের শেয়ার বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে, যার নেতৃত্বে এথার ও জেটওয়ার্ক, কারট্রেড ২২% কমেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: New-age tech stocks largely advanced this week, with quarterly earnings driving sharp moves in individual counters. Of the 69 stocks…
paragraph1: New-age tech stocks largely advanced this week, with quarterly earnings driving sharp moves in individual counters. Of the 69 stocks under Inc42’s coverage, 40 gained between 0.2% and 26.8%, while the remaining 29 declined by up to 22.3%. Ather Energy led the gainers after reporting its maiden quarterly net profit. The stock rose 26.8% to close at ₹1,755.05, having touched a fresh all-time high of ₹1,782.05 during the week. Recently listed Zetwerk followed with an 18% gain, while Tonbo Imaging rose 15.3%. Besides Ather, Nykaa, Eternal, and Shadowfax touched fresh 52-week highs. However, 15 stocks, including Swiggy, FirstCry, MapmyIndia, and LEAP India, hit fresh lows during the week. Gains in larger companies helped lift the combined market cap of the 69 stocks to $160.94 Bn, up 5.7%, or $8.62 Bn, from $152.32 Bn at the end of the previous week. Here are some key developments from listed new-age tech companies during the week. ESDS’ CTO Resigns: AI cloud provider ESDS’ chief technology officer and chief information officer Sajiv Nair resigned, citing personal reasons. He will leave the company on or before January 27, 2027.

title: E2W Registrations Rise 2.9% MoM To 2.15 Lakh In October, TVS & Hero Gain Market Share
title_bn: ই-টু-ডাব্লু রেজিস্ট্রেশন বেড়ে ২.৯ শতাংশ হয়েছে, যা ২.১৫ লক্ষেরও বেশি।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: India’s electric two-wheeler (E2W) registrations rose 2.9% to 2,14,654 units in October from 2,08,688 units in September, with TVS Motor…
paragraph1: SUMMARYIndia’s E2W registrations increased 2.9% MoM to 2.15 Lakh units in October, marking a second consecutive month of growth and a 48.1% YoY rise Hero MotoCorp’s registrations grew faster than those of its top-five rivals, bringing its market share to 13.4%, closing the gap with Ather Energy TVS retained the lead with a 27.2% market share, while Bajaj Auto, Ather Energy, and Ola Electric recorded MoM registration declines of 4.3%, 1.8%, and 13.7%, respectively India’s electric two-wheeler (E2W) registrations rose 2.9% to 2,14,654 units in October from 2,08,688 units in September, with TVS Motor and Hero MotoCorp gaining market share. According to Vahan data as of 16:00 IST today, registrations increased for the second consecutive month, although growth slowed from September’s rebound. Inc42 had reported a 12.2% MoM increase to 2.07 Lakh registrations in September, based on data available on October 1.
paragraph2: The latest figures put September registrations at 2,08,688 units, implying 13% growth over August’s revised tally of 1,84,671 units. October registrations rose 48.1% YoY from 1,44,980 units a year earlier. The month also recorded the highest registrations in the October 2025-October 2026 period covered by the data. However, performance varied across manufacturers. TVS and Hero MotoCorp recorded gains, while Bajaj Auto, Ather Energy, and Ola Electric saw registrations decline. TVS Leads, Hero Gains TVS retained the top spot, with registrations rising 7.4% to 58,425 units from 54,399 units in September. Its market share increased to 27.2% from 26.1%. Bajaj Auto remained second despite a 4.3% decline in registrations to 46,658 units from 48,740 units. Its market share fell to 21.
paragraph3: 7% from 23.4%. Hero MotoCorp recorded the strongest growth among the top five manufacturers. Its registrations jumped 17.5% MoM to 28,720 units, lifting its market share to 13.4% from 11.7%. This narrowed its registration gap with third-placed Ather Energy to 1,660 units from 6,507 units in September. Ather’s registrations declined 1.8% to 30,380 units from 30,942 units in September, while its market share slipped to 14.2% from 14.8%. Manufacturers Plan Capacity Expansion The registration declines at Ather and Bajaj came amid capacity constraints flagged by both companies. Ather said it estimates missing out on around 20,000 potential retail sales a month because of supply constraints.
paragraph4: Its customer pre-orders more than doubled to around 1.8 Lakh during the September quarter, equivalent to approximately 60,000 a month, against average monthly production of around 33,000 units. The company said its Hosur facility reached 98% capacity utilisation during peak production in Q2 FY27. It plans to add 2.25 Lakh units of annual production capacity across its facilities by Q2 FY28, taking combined installed capacity to around 11.4 Lakh units. Bajaj Auto also flagged capacity constraints across its EV businesses. CFO Dinesh Thapar said during the company’s earnings call that manufacturing limitations meant it could deliver only 75% of its planned volumes. The company plans to increase monthly Chetak production capacity to approximately 80,000 units by Q4 FY27 from 64,000 units currently. Meanwhile, TVS announced plans in October to increase E2W production to 80,000 units a month by March 2027. Ola Electric’s Registrations Decline Further Ola Electric’s registrations fell 13.7% to 11,614 units in October from 13,458 units in September. Its market share dropped to 5.4% from 6.
paragraph5: 4%. The decline comes amid the company’s efforts to revive its sales and distribution network, alongside its push into more affordable products and in-house battery technology. Yesterday, it closed its ₹1,000 Cr rights issue. Among smaller manufacturers, Greaves Electric Mobility’s registrations increased 12.3% MoM to 10,468 units, while River recorded a 15.7% rise to 6,533 units. E-Sprinto’s registration growth moderated to 6.4% MoM in October from over 1,500% in September. It registered 2,124 units during the month. The company also launched its G1 family electric scooter in October, marking its entry into the B2C segment. Deliveries are scheduled to begin on January 1, 2027, with the company targeting sales of around 5,000 G1 units by March 2027.

title: ASRock B860 Challenger Wifi Motherboard Review: Entry-level ATX at a great price, with drawbacks
title_bn: ASRock B860 চ্যালেঞ্জার ওয়াইফাই মাদারবোর্ড পর্যালোচনাঃ দুর্দান্ত মূল্যে এন্ট্রি-লেভেলের এটিএক্স, অসুবিধাগুলি সহ
author: TechPulse
excerpt: ASRock’s B860 Challenger Wifi covers the basics and performs well, but slower USB ports, weaker VRMs, and a dated BIOS keep it from standing out, even at the lower price.
paragraph1: The ASRock B860 Challenger Wifi is a solid $149 budget motherboard that handles our Intel Core Ultra 270K Plus without issue, but its USB is capped at 5 Gbps, sports weaker power delivery, and its BIOS is behind the times. Reasons to buy +Excellent price +No Lane/Bandwidth sharing +OpenClaw AI software included Reasons to avoid -USB ports top out at 5Gbps -Paltry power delivery -BIOS still needs a refresh Why you can trust Tom's Hardware Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test. Go to page: Based on the mainstream B860 chipset, the ASRock B860 Challenger Wifi sits on the budget side of Intel's motherboard lineup, and costs a reasonable $149.99.
paragraph2: You get a full-sized motherboard with full support for Intel’s Core Ultra and Core Ultra Series 2 (Arrow Lake and Arrow Lake refresh) processors. Still, some sacrifices in specs and features are inevitable at this price point.The all-black B860 Challenger (there is a white version, too) includes all the basics. You get eight rear USB ports, three M.2 sockets (one PCIe 5.
paragraph3: 0), four SATA ports, 2.5 GbE, Wi-Fi 7, and a basic audio solution. It falls a bit short on USB speed (5 Gbps max.), power delivery isn’t strong (though it handled our 270K Plus without issue at stock), and ASRock’s BIOS is fully functional but dated compared to the competition. It has everything that most will need from a motherboard, but it’s not the fastest or the best at anything, which you should generally expect from a low-priced mainstream chipset.
paragraph4: Performance on this board was actually quite good in our testing. I have to admit, that surprised me a little given the VRM configuration. I expected it to throttle on some longer-running multi-threaded benchmarks. But the B860 Challenger proved me wrong and was average to above average across most of our tests. Whether gaming, doing office work, or juggling creative workflows, the Challenger handled our Intel Core Ultra 270K Plus without issue, though the VRMs ran hotter than on other tested boards.
paragraph5: I would suggest using a chassis with good airflow with this board, especially if you plan to run a high-end processor and long-running, heavily multi-threaded applications.Below, we’ll examine the B860 Challenger's tested performance and other features to see if it earns a spot on our list of the best motherboards. title: I took two iPhones on vacation. The Duo won me over.
title_bn: আমি ছুটিতে দুইটা আইফোন নিয়ে এসেছি।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The iPhone Duo has its frustrations, but it’s also fun and engaging enough that I didn’t want to switch back to my Pro Max.
paragraph1: “I think I’m going to switch back to my other iPhone.” I’ll admit, I said this multiple times during my five-day vacation with the new iPhone Duo, after encountering frustrations with broken apps, unfamiliar gestures (a return to Touch ID, argh!), and camera concerns that had me lugging around two phones. By the time the trip was over, I didn’t want to go back. Image Credits:Cheddar When I first unboxed the Duo, a loaner from Apple, I was genuinely intrigued. I felt a flutter of anticipation as I peeled back the factory seal wrap and booted up the device. In retrospect, this was probably the first signal that Duo was going to ultimately win me over. As a tech reporter, I’ve received a lot of test devices over the years, so unfortunately, opening a package with a new gadget inside is no longer the thrill it used to be. But sometime in the days leading up to the Duo’s ship date, I found myself actually wanting one – I had started doing the math and comparing upgrade options that would allow me to afford the $2K the phone would cost. I started scrolling TikTok reviews of Duo cases. I hesitated not only because of the price but because moving to the Duo is a major change – especially coming from an iPhone 17 Pro Max. The phones could not be more different. As I was about to head out on vacation when the Duo arrived, I decided to tote my 17 Pro Max with me too, as something of a safety net. I ended up using the Duo more, and grew comfortable with it over the course of the trip, despite some frustrations. Image Credits:Cheddar There’s always a psychological switching cost in changing phones, but particularly going from a high-end phone to a more experimental device like the Duo. For someone used to the iPhone’s long-perfected tech and thin rectangular shape, the Duo’s short, squat, and decidedly novel nature was somewhat off-putting at first. “Where is all that screen real estate I used to have?” I lamented.
paragraph2: “Will this thing even fit comfortably in my pocket?” As it turns out, it does. Front and back pockets, in fact. Even while wearing a case. You can sit down with it in your back pocket, effectively squashing it, and it does not break. (I meant to be more careful, but I forgot to be, repeatedly, as I tend to carry phones in my back pocket when walking around. I sat on the phone countless times. It’s clearly not that fragile.) I also dropped the phone (by accident!) at least three times. Twice from about table height and once when it got pushed off the side of the bed. It did not fall on soft carpet, but rather on concrete, tile, and wood floors. It didn’t break then either, and the screen didn’t crack. I wouldn’t call these professional drop tests by any means, but it certainly was a relief for someone fairly clumsy with their phone. Image Credits:Cheddar Of course, I did encounter some frustrations. I had to scroll more to read back through text threads because of the Duo’s small outer screen; unoptimized apps with numerous controls sometimes had key features tucked away in a “more” (three-dot) menu, leading to a hunt to find the option you needed; and, on multiple occasions, the Google Search app just froze. Though not Apple’s fault, the latter turned out to be my biggest annoyance software-wise, given that Search is one of my go-to apps especially when traveling. On vacation, I open the app repeatedly to look up points of interest, restaurant reviews, distances between towns, weather, and more.
paragraph3: But Google’s app would just stop working, and tapping its back button did nothing. This seemed to be a problem specific to the Search app’s AI Mode, which these days you’re often dropped into without actually requesting it. (Even more reason to be annoyed by AI Search!) The workaround has been to force-close the app, so the next time you open it, your returned to the home screen with the search box. (It amazes me that, in a time when Google is facing a search decline because of AI, it wouldn’t have prioritized making its Search app functional on Apple’s latest device!) In addition, many of the early reviews pointed out how many apps were not updated or redesigned for Duo at launch, which meant they had a telltale black bar on the side, cramping the limited screen real estate when the phone is closed even further. This is true, but personally speaking, I didn’t think it was a dealbreaker for making a switch to the Duo. Image Credits:Pinterest screenshot For one thing, companies have been pushing out their Duo-optimized updates fairly quickly. Those that have not – and there are still more than a few! – continue to be usable. They’re just kind of … ugly. Google Maps was not Duo-optimized during the trip, yet I had no problem using it for driving directions, local search and discovery, route planning, and the like. If anything, the black-barred apps felt more like an aesthetic issue than a functional problem, even though they’re smaller than usual when the Duo is folded. I expect all the major apps will eventually update. As for the older apps that never do? Well, it’s probably time to move on from apps no longer being maintained, I’d say, particularly in an era when older software is being exploited left and right by AI-enabled hacking tools. However, I will agree with the other reviewers who complained about the lack of Face ID. This is the Duo’s biggest drawback – not the screen, not the camera, not the lack of an Action button for launching your preferred AI assistant.
paragraph4: It’s Touch ID. Image Credits:Apple It is much easier to look at your phone than to fiddle around with finger presses. While I easily avoided the need to use Touch ID to unlock the device – I am almost always wearing an Apple Watch, which serves as an alternative authentication method – I often stumbled when it came to using apps and Apple Pay. Tap-and-pay is one of the areas where it’s immediately obvious how much smoother Face ID has made everyday tasks. Returning to Touch ID at the time of payment was cumbersome, given that you’re often holding shopping bags, a purse, and, in my case, a dog leash, in addition to the phone you’re using to pay with. There’s a certain amount of what I guess I’ll call “muscle memory” that you have to overcome when you switch back to Touch ID. I found the easiest grip was to cradle the phone in your hand and use your thumb to authenticate. But where I repeatedly messed up was remembering to keep my thumb or finger on the Touch ID sensor long enough to authenticate. At times, my finger wasn’t situated quite right (I blame the dog pulling on the leash!), and I had to readjust. “I miss Face ID!,” I complained multiple times at checkout. Though returning to Touch ID was something I got used to, it’s far from ideal. I can see this as being a real stopping point for some early adopters who would otherwise want to move to the Duo. It’s not an insurmountable problem, but it’s among the top reasons not to get the Duo now, in my opinion. (A future version is said to support Face ID.) Image Credits:Apple Another reason to be wary of the Duo? The camera.
paragraph5: Much has been said about the Duo’s lesser camera system. The Duo has two rear cameras to my iPhone 17 Pro Max’s three. It has no telephoto lens. It has a 10x digital zoom versus the Pro’s 40x. The Pro has more advanced hardware for low-light photography and supports ProRAW, ProRes, and other advanced features. Very simply put: if you are an iPhone photographer or a content creator, you shouldn’t consider the Duo as your primary device. For, you know, us normal folks, the Duo’s camera is okay. Not great, but fine. What were you going to do with those photos you’re snapping anyway? Post them to Instagram Stories or Facebook? Text them to a friend? Look back on them fondly when they reappear in your photo widget on your Home Screen? Turn them into a Lock Screen wallpaper? None of these things requires a Pro-level camera.

It has a 10x digital zoom versus the Pro’s 40x. The Pro has more advanced hardware for low-light photography and supports ProRAW, ProRes, and other advanced features. Very simply put: if you are an iPhone photographer or a content creator, you shouldn’t consider the Duo as your primary device. For, you know, us normal folks, the Duo’s camera is okay. Not great, but fine. What were you going to do with those photos you’re snapping anyway? Post them to Instagram Stories or Facebook? Text them to a friend? Look back on them fondly when they reappear in your photo widget on your Home Screen? Turn them into a Lock Screen wallpaper? None of these things requires a Pro-level camera.

excerpt: Delhi NCR-based B2B manufacturing startup CapGrid has raised ₹50 Cr (about $5.2 Mn) in a Pre-Series B round to develop…
paragraph1: SUMMARYCapGrid has raised ₹50 Cr in a pre-Series B round led by Hero Enterprise Venture Partners at a valuation of ₹430 Cr The startup plans to develop higher-end precision components and enter drone manufacturing and data centres, expanding beyond automotive, consumer durables, and heavy industries CapGrid reported around ₹240 Cr in FY26 operating revenue and expects ₹350 Cr in FY27, while its annualised revenue run rate stands at ₹360-370 Cr Delhi NCR-based B2B manufacturing startup CAPGRID has raised ₹50 Cr (about $5.2 Mn) in a Pre-Series B round to develop higher-end precision components and expand into sectors such as drone manufacturing and data centres. The funding round values CapGrid at ₹430 Cr (about $45.3 Mn), cofounder and CEO Dheeraj Tiwari told Inc42. Led by Hero Enterprise Venture Partners, the investment arm of Sunil Munjal-led Hero Enterprise, it included primary and secondary transactions, with participation from Axilor Ventures, Anicut Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and angels. Part of the primary proceeds will fund R&D into higher-end engineered precision components, while the remainder will support business growth, Tiwari said. CapGrid previously raised $5 Mn in an extended Series A round led by Anicut Growth Fund.
paragraph2: Matching Suppliers With Orders Founded in 2021 by Tiwari and Himanshu Raghuvanshi, CapGrid serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier I suppliers across automotive, consumer durables, and heavy industries. It owns no factories. Instead, its cloud manufacturing platform coordinates component design, development, production, and delivery through third-party manufacturers. CapGrid says it uses AI and ML to match orders with suppliers and track production schedules and quality requirements. According to the startup, its supplier partners operate at around 60% capacity. CapGrid pools orders from different OEMs to put that spare capacity to use. Its supply chain control tower tracks sourcing, procurement, production, and deliveries, while 14 fulfilment centres across India’s major OEM clusters manage inventory and component deliveries to assembly lines.
paragraph3: CapGrid also offers new product development, import localisation, and value engineering, helping customers develop parts, replace imports, and improve component designs and sourcing costs. Moving Beyond Automotive CapGrid initially focused on automotive, tapping manufacturers’ need to source components and manage suppliers. India’s auto component industry recorded turnover of ₹7.59 Lakh Cr in FY26, up 12.7%, according to ACMA. Supplies to OEMs increased 16.3% to ₹6.
paragraph4: 52 Lakh Cr. Having expanded beyond automotive, CapGrid now plans to enter drone manufacturing and data centres. Tiwari said operating revenue grew around 14% to ₹240 Cr in FY26, with ₹350 Cr targeted for FY27. Its annualised revenue run rate has risen from around ₹300 Cr six months ago to ₹360-370 Cr, with ₹500 Cr the next target. Inc42 Take: Can CapGrid Move Up The Manufacturing Value Chain? CapGrid’s next bet is to move beyond consolidating component procurement into higher-end engineered parts. Its existing OEM relationships and supplier network give it a base to build on, but spare factory capacity alone will not establish an advantage in more complex manufacturing.
paragraph5: It will depend on the engineering expertise CapGrid brings to component development and production. The commercial question is whether this shift can improve the economics of its business. Operating revenue grew around 14% in FY26, while its FY27 target implies substantially faster growth. Entering drones and data centres could widen its customer base, but without margin and working-capital disclosures, it remains unclear whether more complex orders will translate into better returns.

title: Top Stories: Apple's Big MacBook Pro, iPad mini and iMac Updates

excerpt: One busy week after another for Apple has left our heads spinning, with this week seeing several Mac updates as well as a revamped iPad mini. All of this week's craziness comes right on the heels of last Friday's iPhone Duo launch, not to mention all
paragraph1: One busy week after another for Apple has left our heads spinning, with this week seeing several Mac updates as well as a revamped iPad mini. All of this week's craziness comes right on the heels of last Friday's iPhone Duo launch, not to mention all of the other products now available or still in pre-order status, so read on below for all of the details! Top Stories Everything Apple Announced This Week It's been a busy October for Apple, and the company ended the month with a bang by introducing a number of new products even as some of the previously announced ones from earlier this month have yet to become available. If you missed the news over the first three days of this week, we've rounded up all our coverage in one spot, so it's easy to take a look back. All of the new products are available for pre-order now, with a launch set for Friday, November 6. Apple Announces OLED MacBook Pro With Touch Display The headliner for the week was Wednesday's introduction of the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display. It's a mouthful, but it's the culmination of several years of rumors about a MacBook Pro with an OLED touchscreen, plus it includes several other upgrades such as lighter weights, a reinforced hinge to stabilize the display while it's being touched, a Dynamic Island instead of a notch, and even the return of an illuminated Apple logo on the lid. The new machines are being sold alongside the previous MacBook Pro models with mini-LED displays, with the PROLED models carrying $400 price premiums over their counterparts even though they use the same M5 Pro and M5 Max chip options.
paragraph2: Apple Announces New 14-Inch MacBook Pro With M6 Chip The low end of the MacBook Pro family also got an update this week, with Apple announcing a speed-bumped M6 version of the 14-inch base model. The M6 chip in the ‌MacBook Pro‌ features a 12-core CPU with 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores, paired with a 12-core GPU. This is up from the M5 chip with a 10-core CPU with 4 super cores and 6 efficiency cores, paired with a 10-core GPU. Alongside the M6 chip, the new 14-inch ‌MacBook Pro‌ now features support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity via Apple's N1 wireless chip. It can also now drive dual external 4K displays at up to 165Hz, up from 144Hz. Apple Announces New iMac With M6 Chip and More The 24-inch iMac also got a speed bump this week, with Apple's all-in-one desktop moving from the M4 chip to the M6 for faster performance and adding an N1 chip with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 support, faster SSD speeds, and more. The new iMac has the same design as the previous model, and the color options remain the same: blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver. Apple Announces New iPad Mini With 8.
paragraph3: 5-Inch OLED Display, A20 Pro Chip, and More This week wasn't all about the Mac lineup, with Apple also taking the wraps off of a redesigned iPad mini featuring a larger 8.5-inch display that uses OLED technology for the first time. In addition, the new iPad mini features a thinner and lighter design, an A20 Pro chip, a new Acoustic Display audio system that eliminates speaker holes, IP67-rated water and dust resistance, a landscape front camera, Apple's N1 chip with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 support, and more. Altogether, Apple says this amounts to the iPad mini's "biggest update ever." Mac Studio With M5 Ultra Now Available With 512GB RAM for $22,299 When Apple introduced the M5 Max and M5 Ultra Mac Studio back in August, it said that a high-end M5 Ultra option with 512GB of memory would become available in late October, and it's finally here for an eye-popping price of $22,299. This configuration is obviously only intended for hungriest of power users, requiring the highest-end chip with a 36-core CPU and 80-core GPU. The memory upgrade alone to increase from the standard 96GB to 512GB costs $15,500. Crackgate?
paragraph4: iPhone Duo Owners Report Screens Breaking Along the Hinge With all of the announcements this week, it's easy to forget that the groundbreaking iPhone Duo just launched last Friday, and while early adopters have been enjoying much of what Apple's first foldable phone has to offer, it hasn't been entirely smooth sailing. At least a few users have experienced sudden interior screen breakage seemingly caused by something going wrong in the complex hinge of the device. Apple has said that it is aware of the issue affecting "a small number of iPhone Duo units" and that affected users should contact AppleCare to obtain replacement units. MacRumors Newsletter Each week, we publish an email newsletter like this highlighting the top Apple stories, making it a great way to get a bite-sized recap of the week hitting all of the major topics we've covered and tying together related stories for a big-picture view. So if you want to have top stories like the above recap delivered to your email inbox each week, subscribe to our newsletter! October 13 looks to be the date for an introduction of Apple's revamped smart home portfolio, including the home hub device we've been hearing about for ages. This week also...

title: Intel shifts production capacity from consumer to server CPUs in face of 'unprecedented' AI demand
title_bn: ইন্টেল 'অপ্রতিরোধ্য' এআই চাহিদার মুখে উৎপাদন ক্ষমতা গ্রাহক থেকে সার্ভার সিপিইউতে স্থানান্তর করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Intel is expanding chipmaking and advanced packaging capacity across the U.S., Ireland, and Malaysia to meet surging AI-driven demand for data center CPUs amid shrinking PC market and persistent supply constraints.
paragraph1: Although the consumer PC market is shrinking and will continue to shrink in the coming quarters, Intel is confident that the overwhelming demand from the AI industry for everything that can compute or store data will offset declines in the client space.
paragraph2: To that end, the company is reallocating some of its capacity from client to data center CPUs, expanding its Fab 24 in Ireland to make more Xeons, has begun equipment installation into Fab 62 in Arizona ahead of schedule and vows to make 18A chips there, and is expanding its advanced packaging capacity in New Mexico and Malaysia.

title: Developer builds a complete Intel 486 PC emulator in a browser
title_bn: ডেভেলপার একটি ব্রাউজারে একটি সম্পূর্ণ ইন্টেল 486 পিসি এমুলেটর তৈরি করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: A developer has created a full Intel 486 PC system, using 100% pure-JavaScript, in a browser.
paragraph1: Developer Jan de Jager has created a full Intel 486 PC system in a browser. On the e486-web GitHub page, de Jager boasts that the emulator is coded in 100% pure JavaScript.
paragraph2: The project’s fuller title is the Retro486 Modular Browser PC. Claude gets a development credit, so we guess you could say e486-web was (partially) vibe-coded.
paragraph3: The live demo you can boot with a single click is impressive, with tabs to interact with and configure your browser-based, dependency-free Intel 80486DX2-66 PC in a browser. The first tab is dubbed the CRT monitor, and this is where you will spend the most time using the command line, apps, and games.
paragraph4: However, it is also very appealing to be able to adjust your PC configuration in the tabs for Motherboard & Slots, Storage Bay, Custom Card Studio, and System & Diagnostics.Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.

title: Anthropic's Claude AI blocks video game cloning and reverse-engineering
title_bn: এন্থ্রপিকের ক্লাউড এআই ভিডিও গেম ক্লোনিং এবং রিভার্স ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিংকে ব্লক করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 model blocking attempts at videogame recreation — users also claim their non-malicious generic reverse-engineering tasks are block
paragraph1: (Image credit: Getty Images) Reverse-engineering games for converting them between systems is currently a hot topic, and it's getting messier by the day. According to multiple user claims, Anthropic's Claude Code and/or Opus 5.5 model are blocking attempts at innocuous reverse-engineering, including but not limited to those using the popular Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) tool. That issue may be linked to a text rule that's now in force, which allegedly instructs the model to avoid "[recreating] a specific existing game."
paragraph2: The updated rule appears to be a move to limit a flood of AI-cracked and cloned titles, with some game devs even recently being hit by extortion scams that threaten to clone their game demos into complete games before they have a chance to finish and release the original.According to Twitter user Chasm, the game-related textual rule is "Do build original games, games in a genre, and games from the user’s own designs and assets. Don’t build a recreation of a specific existing game, even if it is renamed or called original." There is no official or additional confirmation if this is the actual rule text, but it's plausible enough given the very clear refusals that devs have been encountering over the past week.
paragraph3: This situation is tricky to analyze due to the varying types of reports. First, the existence of a game-related rule is real, as Claude Code's GitHub is seeing an influx of issues complaining about refusals to do standard game work halfway through development, when replicating a game mechanic, and patching a tabletop-like game. It's possible that some of those reports have been made by users with nefarious purposes, but at least one is a bona fide developer with a real track record.Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.

He's obsessed with detail and has a tendency to ramble on the topics he loves. When not doing that, he's usually playing games, or at live music shows and festivals.

title: India Can Build Rockets, But Can Its VCs Fund The Next One?
title_bn: ভারত রকেট তৈরি করতে পারে, কিন্তু এর ভার্চুয়াল বিনিয়োগকারীরা কি পরবর্তী রকেট নির্মাণে অর্থায়ন করতে পারবে?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: On July 18, 2026, Skyroot Aerospace achieved a historic milestone when its Vikram-1 rocket successfully placed satellites into orbit, becoming…
paragraph1: On July 18, 2026, Skyroot Aerospace achieved a historic milestone when its Vikram-1 rocket successfully placed satellites into orbit, becoming the first privately developed Indian rocket to accomplish an orbital launch. For a country whose space programme was historically dominated by ISRO, it was a powerful demonstration of what Indian entrepreneurs could achieve in advanced technology. Three months later, Ashlee Vance — the American journalist best known for his bestselling biography of Elon Musk and reporting on the global space industry — turned his attention to India’s technological ambitions. His question was less about the capabilities of Indian engineers than the willingness of Indian investors to back them. He asked: “Why are Indian VCs so afraid to take risk and make money?” The October 22 post accompanied Vance’s Core Memory feature exploring India’s emerging hardware economy. After three weeks meeting 15 Indian companies, Vance appeared impressed by the technological ambitions of their founders but far less enthusiastic about the state of the country’s venture capital ecosystem. He subsequently doubled down, claiming he had rarely encountered a market where VCs had a worse reputation among founders. What followed was an unusually candid debate. Founders complained about investors demanding commercial traction before technologies had been validated, prolonged diligence processes and excessive dependence on founder pedigree. Investors pushed back, highlighting India’s growing list of deeptech successes, the increasing availability of specialist capital and the structural challenges of financing scientific innovation. But the timing makes this debate far more consequential than another disagreement on X. As AI threatens to automate parts of the software-services industry that helped establish India as a global technology powerhouse, the country’s ability to create and own foundational technologies is becoming increasingly important.
paragraph2: India has demonstrated that its entrepreneurs can build complex technologies. The more difficult question is whether venture capital and private equity can repeatedly back such breakthroughs. Indian Founders Aren’t Just Questioning Capital, They’re Questioning The VCs One of the strongest responses came from Akash Kulgod, founder of Dognosis, which is developing canine-assisted cancer detection technology. In a detailed post, Kulgod compared his experience interacting with approximately 80 investors, around 65% of whom were based in the US. His criticism ran deeper than simply stating that Indian VCs rejected his startup. He said US investors typically made relatively quick decisions, rejecting the opportunity when they lacked conviction in the technology or founding team. Some Indian investors, he alleged, extended discussions over repeated meetings and visits, only to demand commercial traction or stop responding. For a company developing medical technology, any delays in the development cycle hurt. Clinical validation, technical testing and regulatory approvals can require years before meaningful commercial revenue becomes possible. An investor demanding revenue before the technology is proven may effectively eliminate the opportunity instead of properly evaluating the technology. Kulgod also questioned whether some investors possessed the technical understanding needed to assess unfamiliar scientific problems. Other founders raised concerns about investor dependence on IIT or IIM credentials, professional networks and the reputations of existing backers when evaluating early-stage startups. These are undoubtedly individual accounts, not evidence that such practices are universal across Indian VC firms.
paragraph3: But they expose an uncomfortable question. If investors require commercial traction, institutional validation and another investor’s conviction before writing a cheque, how much technological risk are they actually underwriting? There is an important difference between financing a technology after it works and financing the experiment that determines whether it can work. Deeptech needs both. And as the experience of several founders in India shows, the latter remains one of the most difficult investment decisions. The Numbers Show A Funding Surge, But Are More Founders Benefiting? According to Inc42 DataLabs, Indian deeptech startups raised approximately $500 Mn across 87 deals in 2025. The sector emerged as one of the most active by deal count, but its funding remained substantially below fintech’s $2.5 Bn, enterprise tech’s $1.8 Bn and ecommerce’s $1.7 Bn. The latest quarterly figures, however, suggest that investor preferences are changing. In Q3 2026, deeptech startups raised $290 Mn across 28 funding deals, compared with $105 Mn across 29 deals in the year-ago quarter.
paragraph4: Funding surged 176% YoY, dramatically outpacing the broader startup ecosystem’s 5% growth. Deeptech funding nearly tripled, but the number of funded deals actually declined. Pixxel’s $100 Mn funding round alone accounted for approximately one-third of the deeptech capital deployed during the quarter. Bengaluru captured around 65% of the sector’s funding. At the broader ecosystem level, investors also wrote larger seed cheques to fewer companies. Early stage funding fell 18% YoY to $164 Mn across 93 deals, even as the median cheque size increased 20% to $1.2 Mn. The contrast with the first half of 2026 is instructive. According to Inc42’s H1 2026 funding report, advanced hardware and technology startups raised $365 Mn across a record 66 deals, reflecting an 18% rise in funding and a 53% jump in deal volume. That suggests improving breadth of investment during the first half, followed by greater concentration in the third quarter. There’s no trend to explore here, but this disparity demonstrates why headline funding growth is an insufficient measure of access to capital. Larger investments are increasingly flowing towards a smaller pool of technically validated companies. So the deeper question is whether more first-time founders pursuing unproven technologies are securing their first institutional cheques, which strikes at the heart of what Vance was saying.
paragraph5: Are India’s VCs Backing Convenience Over Breakthroughs? A separate debate over India’s startup funding priorities had already exposed a fundamental divide between founders and investors over where venture capital should flow. In an October 17 post on X, Neosapien founder Dhananjay Yadav questioned why consumer-service startups burning substantial amounts of capital could attract large investments, while deeptech companies generating higher revenues with lower cash burn struggled to raise even a fraction of that money. Responding to Yadav, Untitled Ventures’ Anmol Maini made a provocative claim that much of deeptech could eventually prove to be a “grift”, arguing that quick commerce and on-demand services might contribute more to the economy. Blume Ventures partner Arpit Agarwal offered an explanation rooted in investment economics. Investment capital, he argued, gravitates towards opportunities offering lower perceived risk or disproportionately higher returns. The distinction to note here is that the economic importance of a technology and its attractiveness as a venture investment are not necessarily the same thing. This is consistent with concerns Agarwal had raised in an earlier interview with Inc42, where he explained why capital-intensive original equipment manufacturing (OEM) businesses are often poorly suited to conventional early-stage VC financing. Pixxel founder Awais Ahmed, however, challenged the notion that consumer internet and deeptech should be competing for relevance and the same pie of venture capital. In a detailed post, Ahmed argued that they represent different layers of the same technological economy.
bangla_paragraph1: ১৮ জুলাই, ২০২৬ তারিখে, স্কাইরুট এয়ারস্পেস একটি ঐতিহাসিক মাইলফলক অর্জন করে যখন এর বিক্রম -১ রকেট সফলভাবে উপগ্রহকে কক্ষপথে স্থাপন করে, কক্ষপথের উৎক্ষেপণ সম্পন্ন প্রথম বেসরকারীভাবে বিকশিত ভারতীয় রকেট হয়ে ওঠে। এমন একটি দেশের জন্য যার মহাকাশ কর্মসূচি ঐতিহাসಿಕವಾಗಿ ইসরোর দ্বারা আধিপত্য বিস্তার করেছিল, এটি উন্নত প্রযুক্তিতে ভারতীয় উদ্যোক্তারা কী অর্জন করতে পারে তার একটি শক্তিশালী প্রদর্শন ছিল। তিন মাস পরে, অ্যাশলি ভ্যান্স  তার সেরা বিক্রিত জীবনী ইলন এম এর জন্য বিখ্যাত আমেরিকান সাংবাদিক
bangla_paragraph2: ভারত দেখিয়েছে যে তার উদ্যোক্তারা জটিল প্রযুক্তি তৈরি করতে পারে। আরও কঠিন প্রশ্ন হল ভেঞ্চার ক্যাপিটাল এবং প্রাইভেট ইক্যুইটি বারবার এই ধরনের অগ্রগতিকে সমর্থন করতে পারে কিনা। ভারতীয় প্রতিষ্ঠাতারা কেবল মূলধনকে প্রশ্নবিদ্ধ করছেন না, তারা ভিসিদের প্রশ্নবিস্তারিত করছেন। সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী প্রতিক্রিয়াগুলির মধ্যে একটি এসেছে ডগনোসিসের প্রতিষ্ঠাতা আকাশ কুলগডের কাছ থেকে, যা কুকুর-সহায়িত ক্যান্সার সনাক্তকরণ প্রযুক্তি বিকাশ করছে। একটি বিস্তারিত পোস্টে কুলগোড প্রায় ৮০ বিনিয়োগকারীর সাথে যোগাযোগের অভিজ্ঞতা তুলনা করেছেন।
bangla_paragraph3: কিন্তু তারা একটি অস্বস্তিকর প্রশ্ন তুলেছে। যদি বিনিয়োগকারীদের একটি চেক লেখার আগে বাণিজ্যিক আকর্ষণ, প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক বৈধতা এবং অন্য বিনিয়োগকারীর বিশ্বাসের প্রয়োজন হয়, তারা আসলে কতটা প্রযুক্তিগত ঝুঁকি গ্রহণ করছে? এটি কাজ করার পরে একটি প্রযুক্তির অর্থায়ন এবং এটি কাজ করতে পারে কিনা তা নির্ধারণ করে এমন পরীক্ষার অর্থায়নের মধ্যে একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পার্থক্য রয়েছে। ডিপটেকের উভয়ই প্রয়োজন। এবং ভারতের বেশ কয়েকটি প্রতিষ্ঠাতার অভিজ্ঞতা দেখায়, পরেরটি এখনও সবচেয়ে কঠিন এক।
bangla_paragraph4: তহবিলের পরিমাণ বছরে ১৭৬% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে, যা ব্যাপকভাবে বিস্তৃত স্টার্টআপ বাস্তুতন্ত্রের ৫% বৃদ্ধিকে ছাড়িয়ে গেছে। ডিপটেক তহবিলে প্রায় তিনগুণ বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছেন, তবে তহবীলকৃত চুক্তির সংখ্যা আসলে হ্রাস পেয়েছে। পিক্সেলের ১০০ মিলিয়ন ডলারের তহদিল বৃত্তাকার একক ত্রিমাসিকের সময় প্রয়োগ করা ডিপটেক মূলধনের প্রায় এক তৃতীয়াংশ। বেঙ্গালুরু এই খাতের তহবিলের প্রায় ৬৫% ক্যাপচার করেছে। বৃহত্তর বাস্তুতান্ত্রিক স্তরে, বিনিয়োগকারীরা কম সংস্থার কাছে বড় বীজ চেকও লিখেছেন। প্রাথমিক পর্যায়ে তহবাই বছরে ১৮% হ্রাস পেয়েছিল ১$৪ মিলিয়ন ডলার।
bangla_paragraph5: ভারতের ভিসিরা কি সাফল্যের চেয়ে সুবিধাজনকতাকে সমর্থন করছে? ভারতের স্টার্টআপ তহবিলের অগ্রাধিকার সম্পর্কে একটি পৃথক বিতর্ক ইতিমধ্যে প্রতিষ্ঠাতা এবং বিনিয়োগকারীদের মধ্যে ভেঞ্চার মূলধন কোথায় প্রবাহিত হওয়া উচিত সে সম্পর্কে একটি মৌলিক বিভেদ প্রকাশ করেছিল। এক্স-এ 17 অক্টোবর পোস্টে, নিওস্যাপিয়েনের প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ধনঞ্জয় যাদব প্রশ্ন করেছিলেন যে কেন ভোক্তা পরিষেবা স্টার্ট আপগুলি উল্লেখযোগ্য পরিমাণে মূলধনের আগুন ধরে বড় বিনিয়োগ আকর্ষণ করতে পারে, যখন কম নগদ পোড়ার সাথে উচ্চ আয় উপার্জনকারী গভীর প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলি এমনকি একটি

title: Indian Listed New-Age Tech Company Tracker: Market Cap, Revenue & More
title_bn: ভারতীয় লিস্টেড নিউ-এজ টেক কোম্পানি ট্র্যাকার: মার্কেট ক্যাপ, রাজস্ব ও আরও
author: TechPulse
excerpt: For years, we at Inc42 have tracked the Indian tech startup ecosystem and seen it grow from a kid to…
paragraph1: SUMMARYOver 70 Indian new-age tech companies have already crossed the IPO milestone and are now listed on the bourses The cumulative market cap of listed new-age tech companies as of now exceeds $178 Bn 15 new-age companies — AceVector, Moneyview, Rentomojo, ESDS, Purple Style Labs, Turtlemint, Klassroom, Shiprocket, LEAP India, Kissht, Aye Finance, Fractal Analytics, Amagi, Shadowfax and SEDEMAC — have made their public market debut in 2026. For years, we at Inc42 have tracked the Indian tech startup ecosystem and seen it grow from a kid to an adult. Among the clearest signs of evolution and maturity of this ecosystem is the growing number of startups eyeing a public listing now. For Indian companies, achieving a public listing has for long symbolised operational progression, transparency, and long-term viability. For startups, it’s a relatively new but increasingly critical rite of passage, one that not only signals coming of age but also creates pathways for investor exits and wealth creation. Currently, a handful of startups, including the likes of Razorpay, PRISM, PhonePe, among others, are in various stages of their IPO journey. Meanwhile, over 70 Indian new-age tech companies have already crossed the milestone and are now listed on the bourses. The list also includes Indian companies like MakeMyTrip and Freshworks, which are listed on Nasdaq in the US. India’s startup IPO wave reached its peak in 2025, surpassing the previous year’s momentum. While 18 startups listed in 2025, 17 startups have already reached that milestone in 2026.
paragraph2: With companies like Cult.fit, OYO, others, eyeing to tap the public markets this year, the list is only expected to grow further this year. 17 new-age companies — Tonbo Imaging, Zetwerk, AceVector, Moneyview, Rentomojo, ESDS, Purple Style Labs, Turtlemint, Klassroom, Shiprocket, LEAP India, Kissht, Aye Finance, Fractal Analytics, Amagi, Shadowfax and SEDEMAC — have made their public market debut in 2026. As of now, the total market capitalisation of the listed companies stands at over $167 Bn. To consolidate all the information about listed startups, Inc42 has launched the Indian Listed New-Age Tech Company Tracker. From the movement in the shares of the companies since their listing to the financial performance of these companies, the tracker is your one-stop resource to know everything you need about the listed tech companies. Table not loading? Open the tracker. Read our methodology here. Inside The Dalal Street Startup Ride Indian startups had gained a reputation for being “loss making” by prioritising growth at all costs and market share over immediate profitability.
paragraph3: The trend of putting scale ahead of the bottom line was at its peak amid the funding boom of 2020-22. While prioritising growth is not wrong for startups, especially at early stages, the start of funding winter in 2022 gave a reality check to the Indian startup ecosystem. Subsequently, startups started pushing for profitability. Giving further wings to the aggressive profitability push was the ambition to list on the exchanges. While new-age tech companies look to turn profitable before filing their draft IPO papers, those that cross the line manage to stay in the green, data shows. Over 60 of the new-age tech companies are currently profitable. In terms of profits, Groww now leads the pack of new-age tech companies, posting a net profit of ₹2,083 Cr in FY26. Prominent internet companies Paytm and Eternal trail Groww in terms of profitability, raking in profits of ₹553 Cr and ₹366 Cr in FY26, respectively. It is pertinent to mention that these companies have been listed on the bourses for years now, with Info Edge making its public market debut in 2006. While these companies trace their origin back to the 90s, a large majority of the new-age tech stocks under Inc42’s purview are about a decade old.
paragraph4: From a broad perspective, Inc42 data reflects that the median time taken for a startup to get listed on the bourses is 11 years. While listing for 18-year-old ixigo and 19-year-old Fino Payments Bank came relatively much later, ArisInfra’s IPO materialised within four years of its operations. Meanwhile, the new-age tech companies that have made their public market debuts this year generally turned profitable right before their public market debuts. For instance, eyewear major Lenskart reported a net profit of around ₹297 Cr , a significant turnaround from a ₹10 Cr loss in FY24. The company maintained profitability in FY26, raking in a PAT of ₹494 Cr in the fiscal. Urban Company also reported its first consolidated net profit of approximately ₹240 Cr for FY25, it returned to the red in FY26. For the full year FY26, the company reported a net loss of ₹234.8 Cr against a net profit of ₹239.8 Cr in previous year despite seeing a revenue growth of 36% YoY to ₹1,555.5 Cr Sectors Driving India’s Startup IPO Boom The startup sectors producing the most number of listed companies is proportional to the private funding trends witnessed in the Indian startup ecosystem.
paragraph5: The three most funded sectors, fintech, ecommerce and enterprise tech, also house the highest number listed startups. While fintech and ecommerce house 14 names each, 13 enterprise tech startups have listed on the bourses so far. The dominance of the fintech and ecommerce sectors on the bourses is expected to continue as the likes of Tonbo Imaging, Zepto and OYO would soon be making their public market debuts. Delhi NCR Home To Highest Number Of Listed Startups While Bengaluru continues to be the startup capital of India, Delhi and its neighbouring cities Gurugram and Noida account for the most number of listed new-age tech companies. Overall, the Delhi NCR region is home to 27 listed new-age tech companies, ahead of Bengaluru’s ninetineen and Mumbai’s fifteen. While fifteen companies, including Eternal, Delhivery, and Lenskart, call Gurugram their home, Awfis, EaseMyTrip, MapmyIndia and E2E Networks are from Delhi. Noida on the other hand is home to six listed new-age tech companies, including Paytm and IndiQube. Delhi NCR contributes $96 Bn in the cumulative $178 Bn market cap of new-age tech companies. Last updated: Oct 23 The Indian Listed New-Age Tech Company Tracker will be updated periodically with fresh data.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার ৭০টি ভারতীয় নতুন যুগের প্রযুক্তি কোম্পানি ইতোমধ্যে আইপিও মাইলফলক অতিক্রম করেছে এবং এখন এক্সচেঞ্জে তালিকাভুক্ত। তালিকাভিত্তিক নতুন যুগে প্রযুক্তি কোম্পানীগুলির বাজার মূলধন এখন পর্যন্ত ১৭৮ বিলিয়ন ডলারেরও বেশি। ১৫টি নতুন যুগ কোম্পানি  এসিভেক্টর, মনিভিউ, রেনটমোজো, ইএসডিএস, পার্পল স্টাইল ল্যাবস, টার্টলমিন্ট, ক্লাসরুম, শিপ্রকেট, লিপ ইন্ডিয়া, কিশট, আই ফাইন্যান্স, ফ্রেক্টাল অ্যানালিটিক্স, আমাগি, শ্যাডোফ্যাক্স এবং সেডেম্যাক  ২০২৬ সালে তাদের পাবলিক মার্কেটে আত্মপ্রকাশ করেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: কুল্ট.ফিট, ওয়ো, অন্যান্য সংস্থাগুলি এই বছর পাবলিক মার্কেটে ট্যাপ করার লক্ষ্যে রয়েছে, এই তালিকাটি কেবল এই বছর আরও বাড়বে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। 17 টি নতুন যুগের সংস্থা  টনবো ইমেজিং, জেটওয়ার্ক, এসভেক্টর, মানিভিউ, রেনটমোজো, ইএসডিএস, প্যুরপল স্টাইল ল্যাবস, টার্টলমিন্ট, ক্লাসরুম, শিপ্রকেট, লিপ ইন্ডিয়া, কিশট, আই ফাইন্যান্স, ফ্র্যাক্টাল অ্যানালিটিক্স, আমাগি, শ্যাডোফ্যাক্স এবং সেডেম্যাক  2026 সালে তাদের পাবলিক বাজারে আত্মপ্রকাশ করেছে। এখন পর্যন্ত, তালিকাভুক্ত সংস্থাগুলির মোট বাজার মূলধন 167 বিলিয়ন ডলারেরও বেশি।
bangla_paragraph3: 2020-22 এর তহবিলের উত্থানের মধ্যে নিচের লাইনের আগে স্কেল রাখার প্রবণতা তার শীর্ষে ছিল। বিশেষত প্রাথমিক পর্যায়ে, স্টার্টআপগুলির জন্য অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া বৃদ্ধি ভুল নয়, 2022 সালে অর্থায়ন শীতের শুরু ভারতীয় স্টার্ট আপ বাস্তুতন্ত্রকে বাস্তবতা পরীক্ষা দিয়েছে। পরবর্তীকালে, স্টার্টারগুলি লাভজনকতার জন্য চাপ দিতে শুরু করে। আগ্রাসী লাভজনকতা ধাক্কা আরও উইংস দেওয়া ছিল এক্সচেঞ্জে তালিকাভুক্ত হওয়ার উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষা। নতুন যুগের প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলি ফাইল করার আগে লাভজনক হতে চায়।
bangla_paragraph4: বিস্তৃত দৃষ্টিকোণ থেকে, ইনক 42 এর তথ্য প্রতিফলিত করে যে একটি স্টার্টআপের জন্য এক্সচেঞ্জে তালিকাভুক্ত হওয়ার জন্য মধ্যম সময়টি 11 বছর। যদিও 18 বছর বয়সী আইসিজিও এবং 19 বছর বয়সীর ফিনো পেমেন্টস ব্যাংকের তালিকা তুলনামূলকভাবে অনেক পরে এসেছিল, আরিস ইনফ্রা এর আইপিও তার কার্যক্রমের চার বছরের মধ্যে বাস্তবায়িত হয়েছিল। এদিকে, নতুন যুগের প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলি যা এই বছর তাদের পাবলিক মার্কেটে আত্মপ্রকাশ করেছে তারা সাধারণত তাদের পাব্লিক মার্কেটের আত্মপ্রবর্তনের ঠিক আগে লাভজনক হয়ে উঠেছে। উদাহরণস্বরূপ, চশমা লেনসকার্ট একটি বড়
bangla_paragraph5: ফিনটেক, ইকমার্স এবং এন্টারপ্রাইজ টেকের তিনটি সর্বাধিক অর্থায়িত খাতগুলি সর্বাধিক সংখ্যক তালিকাভুক্ত স্টার্টআপগুলির আবাসস্থল। যদিও ফিনট্যাক এবং ইকমার্সে 14 টি নাম রয়েছে, এখনও পর্যন্ত 13 টি এন্টরপ্রাইজ প্রযুক্তি স্টার্ট আপগুলি এক্সচেঞ্জে তালিকাভুত হয়েছে। টনবো ইমেজিং, জেপটো এবং ওআইওর মতো ফিন্টেক এবং ই-কমার্স খাতগুলির এক্সচেঞ্জগুলিতে আধিপত্য অব্যাহত থাকবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে কারণ শীঘ্রই তারা তাদের পাবলিক মার্কেটে আত্মপ্রকাশ করবে। দিল্লি এনসিআর হোম টু হাইয়ার্স্ট নম্বর অফ লিস্টেড স্টার্টআপেজ যখন বেঙ্গালুরু অব্যাহত রয়েছে।

title: This Niagara-inspired launcher could (eventually) be better than the original
title_bn: এই নায়াগারায় অনুপ্রাণিত লঞ্চারটি মূলটির চেয়ে (শেষ পর্যন্ত) ভালো হতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: It's free, open-source, and just a little chaotic.
paragraph1: Andy Walker / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: Niagara Launcher is undoubtedly one of the best Android home screens you can run on a modern Android phone. It’s nippy, loaded with features, and rewards both minimalists and maximalists with its thoughtful feature set. Through its obvious and lesser-known features, I’ve used it to build a brilliant productivity setup that piloted my phone for years.There’s not too much criticism I could level against Niagara, but one thing does stand out. I regularly see posts online from users lamenting the pricing of its Pro version. I was lucky enough to board the Niagara boat early, and snagged it on the cheap during its beta phase. Now that it’s a mainstream launcher, you’ll either have to run the limited free version, fork out a monthly subscription for Pro, or pay for a lifetime unlock that’s large enough to be a budget item.What is your primary reason for choosing a home screen launcher?56 votesPersonally, given Niagara’s talents, I don’t believe the current asking price is outrageous, but for those who don’t believe a launcher should cost anything at all or have already spent cash on other launchers, it’s certainly a bone of contention. So, what if you want a Niagara Launcher-like experience but don’t want to reach for your wallet — what’s the solution?Niagara from another continentAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI recently encountered Victoria Launcher. And no, I wasn’t looking for an open-source Niagara Launcher alternative in particular, but its likeness certainly piqued my interest.
paragraph2: Victoria Launcher is, rather cheekily, named after another voluminous waterfall on planet Earth. And, unsurprisingly, it also borrows its design philosophy from its riverine rival.The obvious tells appear almost immediately after setup. You’ll notice the option to select favorite apps that’ll be pinned to the home screen, similar to Niagara. Long-press an app to immediately add it to an existing or new folder. This is true for all apps, regardless of where you access them on the launcher. Tap and scroll the right-hand side to reveal an alphabetic jump list to access the remainder.At the very top of the home screen, there’s room for multiple widgets in a stack and a Now Playing bar that highlights the currently playing media. Lastly, at the bottom-right of the home screen is the multi-function button, which the user can customize to open search or a specific shortcut.The developer did a remarkable job of mimicking the look and feel of its muse.Imitation, flattery, and all that Victoria packs a few of its own tricks and welcome refinements.Niagara’s free version doesn’t support widget stacking, but Victoria makes this one of its crowning features right off the bat.
paragraph3: You’ll notice the use of Material 3 Expressive elements throughout the settings menu, which is a surprise given the design language used elsewhere in the launcher.The menu itself certainly feels more coherent than that of its rival, and Victoria makes it far easier to search for or manually find the particular toggle you’re looking for. The nebulous settings arrangement was always a weakness in Niagara’s design, and I’m glad Victoria’s developer nixed it.Niagara’s free version doesn’t support widget stacking, but Victoria makes this one of its crowning features.While Victoria doesn’t support ready-made Niagara-like Themes, it certainly offers a plethora of customization options. Text color, font, spacing, icon style, shape, positioning, and wallpaper dim color can all be tweaked. Recent versions have added some missing Niagara features, too, including support for widgets in folders — a copy of my favorite Niagara feature, Popups — and notification lists beneath favorites on the home screen. Both features contribute immensely to the launcher’s usability. These, along with gestures for controlling various app actions, certainly mean you can build a somewhat functional, productive workflow with this launcher.Work fast, break things, fix them, repeatAndy Walker / Android AuthorityVictoria Launcher has barely been my home screen for five days, but I’ve already seen eight updates, some bringing major changes and others merely fixing minor bugs. Since its GitHub debut on September 5, this repo has seen 69 releases, or more than one a day. This project is moving swiftly, and this poses something of a problem for those looking for a stable Niagara Launcher alternative.
paragraph4: My original draft included a paragraph about Victoria’s terrible performance, which was patched in the very next version. A day later, I added a paragraph about the lack of a Popup equivalent. A few hours later, it was added to the launcher. There’s a high chance that even if you’ve settled into a comfortable layout, an update will come along that might alter it. In short, it’s not yet ready to be a full-time, mission-critical home screen. That said, I do feel that it has a much higher ceiling than Niagara.Victoria Launcher has barely been my home screen for five days, but I’ve already seen eight updates.Unlike Niagara, a deliberately slow-moving project that focuses on adding minimal but meaningful features every season or so, Victoria can draw inspiration from various sources, adapt them quickly, and alter them as needed. There are several Niagara Launcher features that haven’t yet debuted in the home app, while this work-fast, break-things approach will almost certainly accomplish the latter and potentially a lot more. Given enough time, it could become a more accomplished Niagara rival, having started life as a clone.Similar philosophies, different executionAndy Walker / Android AuthorityNiagaraSo, which is the better minimal, list-based launcher? It’s a little more complicated than declaring an outright victor.
paragraph5: For those who want a stable, feature-rich, and proven product, Niagara comes out on top. It’s a known quantity, one that I’ve mastered in my own way. However, to get the most out of Niagara, you’ll need to fork out cold, hard cash, a luxury that many users don’t have in this economic climate. Regardless of its feature set, that alone makes Niagara a no-go for plenty.Niagara remains the better minimal, list-style launcher, but Victoria is one to keep an eye on.On the other side of this coin, there’s Victoria Launcher, a free, open-source alternative modeled on Niagara. It gives users a taste of an uncluttered, intentional home screen inspired by one of the best launchers on the market. While it’s not yet up to the polish of its muse, its developers’ insatiable desire to refine it and add new features will only improve the experience. This drive, which often results in multiple updates per day, means Victoria is far too volatile to be considered a daily driver home screen — yet.
bangla_paragraph1: অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অ্যাটর্নিটি যোগ করুন গুগলে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষঃ নায়াগ্রা লঞ্চার নিঃসন্দেহে আধুনিক অ্যান্ড्रয়েড ফোনে চালানো যেতে পারে এমন সেরা অ্যান্ড্রেড হোম স্ক্রিনগুলির মধ্যে একটি। এটি ন্যাপী, বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির সাথে লোড, এবং এটির চিন্তাশীল বৈশিষ্ট্য সেট সহ মিনিমালিস্ট এবং ম্যাক্সিমালিষ্ট উভয়কেই পুরস্কৃত করে। এর সুস্পষ্ট এবং কম পরিচিত বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির মাধ্যমে, আমি এটি একটি উজ্জ্বল উত্পাদনশীলতা সেটআপ তৈরি করতে ব্যবহার করেছি যা আমার ফোনটি বছরের পর বছর ধরে পরীক্ষা করেছে। আমি নায়গারের বিরুদ্ধে খুব বেশি সমালোচনা করতে পারি না, তবে একটি জিনিস স্থির করে।
bangla_paragraph2: ভিক্টোরিয়া লঞ্চার, বরং অবাঞ্ছিতভাবে, গ্রহ পৃথিবীর আরেকটি ভলিউমযুক্ত জলপ্রপাতের নামকরণ করা হয়েছে। এবং, অবাক হওয়ার কিছু নেই, এটি তার নদী প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী থেকে তার নকশা দর্শনও ধার করে। স্পষ্টতই বলে যে সেটআপের পরে প্রায় অবিলম্বে প্রদর্শিত হয়। আপনি পছন্দসই অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলি নির্বাচন করার বিকল্পটি লক্ষ্য করবেন যা হোম স্ক্রিনে পিন করা হবে, নায়াগারের মতো। একটি বিদ্যমান বা নতুন ফোল্ডারে অবিলামেই এটি যুক্ত করতে একটি অ্যাপ্লিকেশান দীর্ঘ চাপুন। এটি সমস্ত অ্যাপ্লিকেशনের জন্য সত্য, আপনি লঞ্চারে সেগুলি কোথায় অ্যাক্সেস করেন তা নির্বিশেষে। একটি ট্যাপ করুন
bangla_paragraph3: আপনি সেটিংস মেনু জুড়ে উপাদান 3 এক্সপ্রেশন উপাদান ব্যবহার লক্ষ্য করবেন, যা লঞ্চারের অন্য কোথাও ব্যবহৃত নকশা ভাষা দেওয়া একটি বিস্ময়। মেনুটি নিজেই অবশ্যই তার প্রতিযোগীর তুলনায় আরও সুসংগত মনে হয়, এবং ভিক্টোরিয়া আপনি খুঁজছেন নির্দিষ্ট টগল অনুসন্ধান বা ম্যানুয়ালি খুঁজে পেতে অনেক সহজ করে তোলে। কুয়াশাচ্ছন্ন সেটিংস বিন্যাস সর্বদা নায়াগার নকশা একটি দুর্বলতা ছিল এবং আমি খুশি ভিক্টরিয়া এর ডেভেলপার এটি নিকেশিত.

bangla_paragraph5: যারা একটি স্থিতিশীল, বৈশিষ্ট্য সমৃদ্ধ, এবং প্রমাণিত পণ্য চান, তাদের জন্য, নায়াগ্রা শীর্ষে আসে। এটি একটি পরিচিত পরিমাণ, যা আমি আমার নিজের উপায়ে আয়ত্ত করেছি। তবে, নাইাগ্রার সর্বাধিক সুবিধা পেতে, আপনাকে ঠান্ডা, হার্ড নগদ, একটি বিলাসিতা যা এই অর্থনৈতিক জলবায়ুতে অনেক ব্যবহারকারীর নেই তা ফর্ক করতে হবে। এর বৈশিষ্ট্য সেট নির্বিশেষে, এটি একা নায়গারকে প্রচুর পরিমাণে একটি নো-গোয় করে তোলে। নায়াগারা আরও ভাল ন্যূনতম, তালিকা-শৈলী লঞ্চার হিসাবে রয়ে গেছে, তবে ভিক্টোরিয়া একটি নজর রাখতে হবে। এই মুদ্রার অন্য দিকে, সেখানে
